  • Broad-Based Margin Expansion (38.11% GAAP GM / 25.2% Adj. EBIT): GAAP gross margin rose +36 bps YoY to 38.11%, GAAP EBIT jumped +79.4% YoY to $983.8M (22.81% margin), and EMEA Adj. operating margin surged +920 bps YoY to 28.0%.

Amit Daryanani (Evercore ISI) • Topic: Organic Order Growth >100% and Liquid Cooling Capacity

Analyst Question: "Giordano, congratulations on organic orders doubling year-over-year. Could you give us more granularity on how much of this order surge is driven by liquid cooling versus traditional power/thermal, and what is your current manufacturing lead time for complete converged modular infrastructure?"

Executive Response: "CEO Giordano Albertazzi explained that while direct-to-chip liquid cooling demand is growing exponentially with high-density AI clusters, traditional power switching, UPS, and hybrid thermal systems also saw immense growth as customers retrofit existing facilities. Lead times for standardized modular power solutions have compressed by 30% due to capacity additions in North America and Europe, while CoolTera CDUs and manifold lines scale ahead of hyperscaler schedules."

Visibility extends through fiscal 2027, supported by $6.2B in total liquidity after the investment-grade credit upgrade and senior notes refinancing."
